name: commit_delay
description: Introduces a microsecond delay before flushing WAL to disk during commit, enabling group commit when other transactions are active.
symptoms: Suboptimal throughput under concurrent commit load
tuning_tips: Set to a small nonzero value (e.g., 1000–10000 us) only under high concurrent commit workloads where group commit opportunities exist; avoid on latency-sensitive systems. Always pair with appropriate commit_siblings.
